title: BI Developer Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on SQL, data modelling, ETL, dashboards, business metrics, Power BI/Tableau, data warehouses, analytics and communicating insights to decision-makers.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. Years 1–2 establish programming, SQL, databases and statistics; Years 3–4 focus on BI platforms, dimensional modelling, ETL/ELT, dashboards, data warehouses, cloud BI and production reporting.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Progress from building dashboards to designing the semantic and data layer behind them. Develop expertise in governance, metric definitions, data quality, self-service analytics, cloud platforms and AI-assisted BI while retaining strong SQL and modelling skills.

PhD routes

Move beyond dashboard production into enterprise analytics architecture. Focus on trusted semantic layers, metric governance, data quality, privacy, self-service analytics, cloud economics and AI-assisted business intelligence. Strong communication and business-domain expertise should complement the technical stack.
